author: Stephanie Tree
text: In desperation, I got graph paper, made a column for date, one for time, one for BS readings, then the rest of the line for activity, or food, descriptions of all the food, snacks, beverages, and more. One page per day. I intend to use this to LEARN from it, and need to see it. It's working! I can analyze by marking noteworthy things. and noting the BS readings, comparing all kinds of new things. 🙂 Patterns, too.
